```{r}

dir_part <- function(x, n = 1) {
  while (n > 1) {
    x <- dirname(x)
    n <- n - 1
  }
  basename(x)
}

get_model <- function(x) {
  dir_part(x, 8)
}

cmip_augment <- function(files) {
  data.table(file = files, model = get_model(files))
}
```

```{r ar_mask}
namask <- daice[,
  .(
    mean_na = mean(is.na(aice)),
    mean_ice = mean(aice, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_valid = sum(!is.na(aice)),
    var = var(aice, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  by = .(lon, lat)
]

ar_mask <- namask[mean_na == 0 & var != 0 & mean_ice > 0.1, .(lon, lat)]

```


```{r daice-monthly-scatter}
daice |>
  _[year(time) <= 2014] |>
  # _[ar_mask, on = .NATURAL] |>
  _[!is.na(daice)] |>
  _[t2m < 2.5] |>
  _[t2m > -20] |>

    "Monthly change in sea ice concentration to the next month"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous("Monthly mean 2-m temperature (°C)") +
  scale_x_continuous("Monthly mean sea ice concentration") +
```

```{r model_monthly}
d <- 5
model_monthly <- lm(
  daice ~ poly(t2m, 3, raw = TRUE) * poly(aice, 3, raw = TRUE),
  data = na.omit(daice),
  subset = t2m < 1 & aice > 0 & year(time) < 2014
)

grid_monthly <- CJ(
  t2m = seq(-20, 5, length.out = 40),
  aice = seq(0, 1, length.out = 40)
) |>
  _[, daice := predict(model_monthly, newdata = .SD)]
```

```{r mean-bias}
mask <- daice_daily[, mean(aice == 0 | is.na(aice)), by = .(lon, lat)][
  V1 < 0.8
][, V1 := NULL][]

daice_daily |>
  copy() |>
  _[mask, on = .NATURAL] |>
  _[, predict := predict(model_daily, newdata = .SD)] |>
  _[,
    .(
      error = mean(predict - daice, na.rm = TRUE),
      aice = mean(aice, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    by = .(lon, lat, month = lubridate::month(time, label = TRUE))
  ] |>
  _[abs(error) < 0.1] |>
  # ggperiodic::periodic(lon = c(0, 360)) |>
  ggplot(aes(lon, lat)) +
  geom_contour_fill(aes(z = error), proj = proj, proj.latlon = FALSE) +
  geom_contour2(data = topo, aes(xgrid, ygrid, z = topo), breaks = 0) +
  geom_contour2(
    aes(z = aice),
    breaks = 0.8,
    color = "red",
    proj = proj,
    proj.latlon = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  scale_fill_gradient2("Mean model bias") +
  facet_wrap(~month) +
  scale_y_continuous(NULL, breaks = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(NULL, breaks = NULL) +
  coord_equal()
```

```{r era_temp_fun}
era_temp_fun <- function(data) {
  t2m_matrix <- data[, .(time, lon, lat, t2m)] |>
    metR:::.tidy2matrix(lon + lat ~ time, value.var = "t2m") |>
    _$matrix
  t2m_time <- 0:(ncol(t2m_matrix) - 1)

  function(t) interpolate_cpp(t2m_matrix, t2m_time, t)
}

```

```{r}
era_temp_fun_back <- function(data) {
  t2m_matrix <- data[, .(time, lon, lat, t2m)] |>
    metR:::.tidy2matrix(lon + lat ~ time, value.var = "t2m") |>
    _$matrix
  t2m_time <- rev(0:(ncol(t2m_matrix) - 1))

  function(t) interpolate_cpp(t2m_matrix, t2m_time, t)
}

```


```{Rcpp poly_interactions_cpp}
#include <Rcpp.h>
using namespace Rcpp;

// [[Rcpp::export]]
NumericMatrix poly_interactions_cpp(NumericVector x1, NumericVector x2, int degree) {
  int n = x1.size();
  if(n != x2.size()) {
    Rcpp::stop("x1 and x2 must have the same length");
  }
  
  // Calculate total number of columns:
  // 1 (intercept) + degree (x1 terms) + degree (x2 terms) + degree*degree (interactions)
  int total_cols = 1 + degree + degree + degree * degree;
  NumericMatrix result(n, total_cols);
  
  int col_idx = 0;
  
  // Column 1: Intercept
  for(int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    result(i, col_idx) = 1.0;
  }
  col_idx++;
  
  // Build polynomial matrices for both variables
  NumericMatrix poly1(n, degree);
  NumericMatrix poly2(n, degree);
  
  // Fill polynomial matrices efficiently
  for(int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    double x1_val = x1[i];
    double x2_val = x2[i];
    double x1_power = x1_val;
    double x2_power = x2_val;
    
    for(int j = 0; j < degree; j++) {
      poly1(i, j) = x1_power;
      poly2(i, j) = x2_power;
      x1_power *= x1_val;
      x2_power *= x2_val;
    }
  }
  
  // Add x1 polynomial terms
  for(int j = 0; j < degree; j++) {
    for(int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      result(i, col_idx) = poly1(i, j);
    }
    col_idx++;
  }
  
  // Add x2 polynomial terms
  for(int j = 0; j < degree; j++) {
    for(int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      result(i, col_idx) = poly2(i, j);
    }
    col_idx++;
  }
  
  // Add all interactions (x1^i * x2^j for i,j = 1 to degree)
  for(int j2 = 0; j2 < degree; j2++) {        // x2 powers
    for(int j1 = 0; j1 < degree; j1++) {      // x1 powers
      for(int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        result(i, col_idx) = poly1(i, j1) * poly2(i, j2);
      }
      col_idx++;
    }
  }
  
  return result;
}
```



```{r d_ice}
d_ice <- function(coefs, inflation = 1) {
  force(coefs)
  force(inflation)
  function(state, time, forcing) {
    t2m <- forcing(time)
    x <- poly_interactions_cpp(t2m, state, 3)

    d_ice <- as.vector(coefs %*% t(x)) * inflation

    d_ice <- fifelse(state >= 1 & d_ice > 0, 0, d_ice)
    d_ice <- fifelse(state <= 0 & d_ice < 0, 0, d_ice)
    d_ice
  }
}
```


```{r d_ice_back}
d_ice_back <- function(coefs) {
  force(coefs)
  function(state, time, forcing) {
    t2m <- forcing(time)
    x <- poly_interactions_cpp(t2m, state, 3)

    d_ice <- -as.vector(coefs %*% t(x))

    d_ice <- fifelse(state >= 1 & d_ice > 0, 0, d_ice)
    d_ice <- fifelse(state <= 0 & d_ice < 0, 0, d_ice)
    d_ice
  }
}
```


```{r rk4}
rk4 <- function(model, state, time, forcing, dt) {
  k1 <- model(state = state, time = time, forcing = forcing)
  k2 <- model(
    state = state + k1 * dt / 2,
    time = time + dt / 2,
    forcing = forcing
  )
  k3 <- model(
    state = state + k2 * dt / 2,
    time = time + dt / 2,
    forcing = forcing
  )
  k4 <- model(state = state + k3 * dt, time = time + dt, forcing = forcing)

  state <- state + (k1 + 2 * k2 + 2 * k3 + k4) * dt / 6

  state
}
```

```{r evolve}
evolve_ <- function(
  start,
  model,
  start_time,
  end_time,
  dt,
  method = rk4,
  forcing
) {
  time <- seq(start_time, end_time, by = dt)
  N <- length(time)

  grid <- start[, .(lon, lat)]
  history <- lapply(time, \(t) copy(grid)[, time := t])

  history[[1]]$aice <- start$aice
  for (n in seq_len(N - 1)) {
    history[[n + 1]]$aice <- method(
      model,
      history[[n]]$aice,
      time[n],
      forcing,
      dt
    )
  }

  history <- data.table::rbindlist(history)
}

evolve <- memoise::memoise(evolve_, cache = cachem::cache_disk("data/cache"))
```

## Integrating this model


$$
\frac{dC_{ij}}{dt} = f(C_{ij}, T_{ij})
$$

Where $C_{ij}$ is sea ice concentration in gridpoint $ij$, $T_{ij}$ is the t2m temperature in gridpoint $ij$ and $f$ is the polynomial fit on monthly values. $T$ comes from ERA5.

```{r}
d_ice_daily <- function(t2m, aice) {
  daice <- sum(coef(model_daily) * c(1, aice, aice^2, t2m, t2m * aice, t2m^2))

  if (aice >= 1 & daice > 0) {
    daice <- 0
  }
  if (aice <= 0 & daice < 0) {
    daice <- 0
  }

  daice
}
```

```{r}
  # geom_contour2(aes(z = aice), breaks = 0.8, color = "red", proj = proj, proj.latlon = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  # scale_fill_gradient2() +
  facet_wrap(~month) +
  scale_y_continuous(NULL, breaks = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(NULL, breaks = NULL) +
  coord_equal()
```


```{r}
eofs <- sim |>
  copy() |>
  # _[lat > -75] |>
  _[,
    value := value - mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    by = .(lon, lat, variable, month(time))
  ] |>
  _[, .(eof = list(EOF(value ~ lon + lat | time, n = 1:10))), by = .(variable)]
```


```{r}
eofs[, eof[[1]]$left, by = variable] |>
  _[PC %in% c("PC2", "PC7")] |>
  ggperiodic::periodic(lon = c(0, 360)) |>
  ggplot(aes(lon, lat)) +
  geom_contour_fill(aes(z = value)) +
  # geom_contour2(data = topo, aes(z = topo), breaks = 0) +
  scale_fill_gradient2() +
  facet_grid(PC ~ variable) +
  coord_polar() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-90, NA)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 360))
```
